inputs.text: [serious] Gorgonops. [pauses] Two pieces, [curious] both Greek. "Gorgon" is the Gorgon, a monster from old Greek stories with a terrifying face.
[gently] So frightening that you were scared just hearing it come closer. [confident] And "ops," in Greek, is face.
[warmly] The whole name, yes — scientists found its skull truly impressive. It lived in South Africa, [amazed] two hundred sixty million years ago, [pauses] way before the first dinosaurs.
